name: AutoCodeBench-V2
intro: AutoCodeBench是一个大规模代码生成基准，包含3920个问题，均匀分布在20种编程语言中。它旨在评估大型语言模型在具有挑战性、多样化和实用性的多语言任务上的表现。该基准利用名为AutoCodeGen的自动化方法生成，通过LLM与多语言沙箱的交互来创建高质量的测试用例，无需人工标注。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.09101 sections on AutoCodeGen and the AutoCodeBench series: extracting Stack-Edu multilingual code seeds, refining self-contained DeepSeek-V3 solutions, validating executable code in a 20+ language sandbox, generating public and private test inputs and sandbox outputs, reverse-generating problem statements with language/I-O/no-hint specifications, applying three-stage filtering through DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite difficulty sampling, DeepSeek-R1 critique, and category tagging, forming the 3,920-problem 20-language benchmark, deriving ACB-Lite by pass-count selection and ACB-Complete for base models, then evaluating 30+ LLMs using Pass@1 and a standardized code-block prompt.
intro_en: AutoCodeBench is a large-scale code generation benchmark consisting of 3,920 problems evenly distributed across 20 programming languages. It aims to evaluate large language models on challenging, diverse, and practical multilingual tasks. The benchmark is generated using an automated method called AutoCodeGen, which creates high-quality test cases through interactions between LLMs and a multilingual sandbox, requiring no manual annotation.
